_meta.indication: For the extended adjuvant treatment of adult patients with early stage HER2-overexpressed/amplified breast cancer, to follow adjuvant trastuzumab-based therapy.

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of one year of neratinib versus placebo.
pivotal_trials.population: Women with early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer within two years of completing adjuvant trastuzumab-based therapy.
pivotal_trials.result: Primary analysis: 67 (4.7%) iDFS events on neratinib vs 106 (7.5%) on placebo; stratified HR 0.66 (95% CI 0.49, 0.90); two-sided stratified log-rank p=0.008; iDFS at 24 months 94.2% vs 91.9%.

key_safety: Diarrhea was the most common adverse reaction, reported in 95% of NERLYNX-treated patients (Grade 3 in 40%, Grade 4 in 0.1%) vs 35% on placebo; other common reactions included nausea (43% vs 22%), abdominal pain (36% vs 15%) and vomiting (26% vs 8%). Diarrhea was also the most common AE leading to discontinuation (16.8%).
target_moa: Neratinib is an orally available small molecule, irreversible pan-ERBB tyrosine kinase inhibitor that inhibits ERBB1 (EGFR), ERBB2 (HER2), and ERBB4 by binding at the intracellular tyrosine kinase domain.

advisory_committee.vote: ODAC convened May 24, 2017; the committee voted 12-4 that ExteNET results support a positive benefit-risk assessment of neratinib for the proposed population.

description.text: Updated labeling to add diarrhea management (antidiarrheal prophylaxis) guidance based on the PUMA-NER-6201 study

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for updates to the Dosage and Administration, Warning and Precautions, Adverse Reactions and Clinical Trials Experience sections of the Full Prescribing Information regarding the management of diarrhea when on Nerlynx® based on the PUMA-NER-6201 interim clinical study report.

description.text: Added indication for neratinib in combination with capecitabine for adults with advanced or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer after two or more prior anti-HER2 regimens

citations.quote: - Supplement 005: A new indication for neratinib, for use in combination with capecitabine, for the treatment of adult patients with advanced or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer who have received two or more prior anti-HER2 based regimens in the metastatic setting.

description.text: Updated labeling with final overall survival analysis from ExteNET trial and added AST to hepatotoxicity dose modifications

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for updates to section 14 of the U.S. prescribing information to include the final overall survival analysis based on results from ExteNET clinical trial. In addition, AST was added to the dose modifications for hepatotoxicity in Table 7.

description.text: Added dosing and management guidance for prevention of neratinib-associated diarrhea based on the CONTROL trial

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for updates to the Dosage and Administration, Warnings and Precautions, and Patient Counseling Information sections of the Full Prescribing Information based on data from the CONTROL trial (PUMA-NER-6201) regarding prevention and management of neratinib-associated diarrhea.

summary.text: NERLYNX (neratinib) was a new molecular entity reviewed as a Standard NDA; approval was based on the single Phase 3 ExteNET trial, and an ODAC meeting was convened on May 24, 2017 which voted 12-4 in support of a positive benefit-risk assessment.

citations.quote: Neratinib is a new molecular entity (NME) and not currently marketed in the United States.

the Division convened an Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) meeting on May 24, 2017, to advise and offer insight on the overall benefit-risk of neratinib in the proposed population. The committee voted 12-4 that the efficacy and safety results of ExteNET supports a positive benefit-risk assessment of neratinib for the proposed population.

requirement.text: 3223-1: Conduct a PBPK modeling/simulation study (or clinical PK trial) to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor on the single-dose PK of neratinib and its active metabolites.

citations.quote: 3223-1 Conduct a physiologically-based pharmacokinetic modeling/simulation study to evaluate the effect of repeat doses of a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor on the single dose pharmacokinetics of neratinib and its active metabolites to assess the magnitude of increased drug exposure and to address the potential for excessive drug toxicity. If the PBPK modeling/simulation is not feasible then a clinical pharmacokinetic trial will be conducted. Submit Final Report, datasets, and labeling.

requirement.text: 3223-2: To assess carcinogenic potential, conduct a 2-year carcinogenicity study in the rat.

citations.quote: 3223-2 To assess carcinogenic potential conduct a 2-year carcinogenicity study in the rat. Refer to the ICH S1A Guidance for Industry on The Need for Long Term Rodent Carcinogenicity Studies of Pharmaceuticals.

requirement.text: 3223-3: Submit the overall survival (OS) data and results from Trial 3144A2-3004-WW (ExteNET).

requirement.text: 3223-4: Conduct a PBPK modeling/simulation study or clinical PK trial with repeat doses of a moderate CYP3A4 inducer on the single-dose PK of neratinib and its active metabolites to determine appropriate dosing recommendations.
